title: Liber de filiabus Adae (Book of the Daughters of Adam)

details.intro:
The Liber de filiabus Adae (Book of the Daughters of Adam / Leptogenesis) is an apocryphal title condemned in the Latin Decretum Gelasianum (§ 6, line 298: Liber de filiabus Adae hoc est Leptogenesis, apocryphus).

The subtitle Leptogenesis ("Little Genesis") confirms that the text condemned under this heading was either the Book of Jubilees itself, or an extract/reworking focusing specifically on the names and genealogies of the wives of the primeval patriarchs (Cain's wife Awan, Seth's wife Azura, etc., as enumerated in Jubilees 4).
details.provenance:
Language: Greek Vorlage; Latin ecclesiastical condemnation.
Date: 2nd century BCE (if Jubilees) to late antiquity.
details.manuscripts:
• Decretum Gelasianum: § 6, 2, v. 298 (ed. E. von Dobschütz, TU 38.4, 1912).
  • Parallel Texts: Book of Jubilees 4:1–33; Epiphanius, Panarion 39.6.
